name: fmp_stock_news
description:
Recent news articles from Financial Modeling Prep (FMP, /stable/stock-news) for one stock, or general market news when no symbol is given: title, text snippet, source site, URL, published date.
Returns {symbol, articles_count, articles}: symbol is "market" when omitted.
Inputs (* required): symbol (ticker, optional; upper-cased), limit (integer 1-50; default 10).
For company announcements use fmp_press_releases; for filings fmp_sec_filings.
Example: {"symbol": "TSLA", "limit": 5}

symbol.description: Stock symbol (optional, omit for general market news)
